meta.name: Monitor churn risk from competitor job posts with JSearch, Google Sheets, and Gmail

name: Churn Risk Monitor - Job Posting Signals + Gmail CSM Alert + Google Sheets Log

parameters.content:
This workflow watches for an early churn signal, a customer hiring for a competitor product. It checks your customer list every week, searches for matching job postings, and alerts the assigned CSM before a renewal is at risk. It is built for SaaS teams who want a lightweight alternative to paid tech stack tracking tools.

### How it works
1. **Schedule Trigger** starts the check every Monday at 8 AM.
2. **Google Sheets** reads your customer list, one row per company.
3. **JSearch** looks up recent job postings for each company.
4. The **Code** node scans those postings for competitor tool names and works out days left until renewal.
5. Rows with a competitor hire inside a 90 day renewal window are marked high risk and pass the IF filter.
6. High risk rows are logged to Google Sheets and trigger a Gmail alert to the CSM.

### Setup steps
1. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2, then replace YOUR_CHURN_MONITOR_SHEET_ID in node 2 and node 6.
2. Sign up free at RapidAPI JSearch and replace YOUR_JSEARCH_API_KEY in node 3.
3. Connect Gmail OAuth2 for node 7.
4. In node 4, update the competitors array with your own competitor names.
5. Activate the workflow. It then runs every Monday at 8 AM.

### Customization
Change the schedule in node 1 for a different day or time.
Adjust the 90 day renewal window in node 4 if your team needs more lead time.
Edit the Gmail message in node 7 to match your brand voice.
The free JSearch tier gives 500 calls a month, enough for about 100 customers checked weekly.

## Google Sheet setup
Tab 1, name it "customers": company_name, company_domain, renewal_date (use YYYY-MM-DD), csm_email, account_tier.
Tab 2, name it "churn-alerts-log": Date, Company, Domain, Job Title Found, Competitor, Days to Renewal, CSM Email, Alert Sent At.
Node 6 writes to churn-alerts-log automatically and the column names must match exactly.

## 1. Trigger and customer list
Runs every Monday at 8 AM and reads all rows from the customers tab in Google Sheets.

## 2. Job posting search
Searches JSearch for recent postings that match each company name plus common competitor tool names.

## 3. Score risk and filter
Checks postings for competitor keywords, works out days to renewal, and only lets high risk rows through.

## 4. Log and alert
Saves every high risk match to the churn-alerts-log tab and emails the assigned CSM with the details.

Why this is a risk

{{ $json.companyName }} has posted a job opening requiring {{ $json.detectedCompetitor }} skills. When a customer hires for a competitor product, they are actively planning to switch. With only {{ $json.daysToRenewal }} days until renewal, this is an urgent signal.

Recommended Actions

  • Schedule a call with your main contact this week
  • Understand what pain points are driving this evaluation
  • Offer a product roadmap review or executive sponsor meeting
  • Consider a retention discount or added value for early renewal
